claimBoundary: This profile qualifies a package-only complete-input progressive JFIF 4:2:0 JPEG slice with ImageCraft-owned padded coefficient planes, fixed per-component quantization/progression state and width-bounded final reconstruction strips. It is not a public production backend.

Interleaved scans are DC-only and use 2x2/1x1/1x1 MCU membership; noninterleaved scans address only each component's actual block rectangle. DC/AC first and refinement scans must obey monotone successive approximation and every introduced coefficient must reach Al=0 before final output.

Generated geometry deliberately crosses libjpeg's width-4/width-5 box-to-fancy chroma branch and height-16/height-17 global-context boundary. Content/quality and restart matrices are supplemented by retained 7/9/10-scan real-photo scripts so conformance is not limited to cjpeg's default ten-scan script.

For every case, ImageCraft's final padded coefficient backing must equal pinned libjpeg-turbo jpeg_read_coefficients byte-for-byte and final RGB must equal pinned djpeg -rgb -dct int byte-for-byte. Exact operation charge must succeed and charge-1 must fail before state/output allocation.

Passing this profile establishes final complete-input entropy/refinement/coefficient/reconstruction conformance for the qualified 4:2:0 domain. It does not yet establish incremental suspension rollback, preview-generation semantics, arbitrary DQT mutation, non-JFIF color authority, scaled IDCT or other sampling modes.
